notes.title: V1.07 Update
notes.content: [p][b]This is a small patch update[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Update Contents:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Multiplayer mode now automatically uploads scores at regular intervals[/p][/*][*][p]Attempted to fix abnormal enemy spawning issues in multiplayer mode[/p][/*][*][p]All in-game music is now placed in the "Music" folder within the game directory[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Note: Players using different versions cannot team up or see each other's room list.[/b][/h3]

notes.content: [p][b]This is a small patch update[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Update Contents:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Optimize in-game lighting effects[/p][/*][*][p]Attempt to fix abnormal enemy spawns in multiplayer mode[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Note: Players using different versions cannot team up or see each other's room list.[/b][/h3]

notes.content: [p][b]This is a small patch update[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Update Contents:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Changed the description of "In-Game Setup" to "Tower Inventory"[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where selling a tower could occasionally cause the game to freeze[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Note: Players using different versions cannot team up or see each other's room list.[/b][/h3]

notes.content: [p]This is an emergency hotfix patch.[/p][p][/p][h2]Update details:[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed abnormal stats issue with the "Thief" tower[/p][/*][*][p]The "Bond" list can now be dragged to the top-left of the screen to remain visible[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled fast-forward function when playing "Multiplayer Mode" solo[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted table display in the "Help" section[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized some lag issues[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Our current main goal is to improve the game experience and fix various issues. New content is also in the works![/p][p][/p][h3]Note: Players using different versions cannot team up or see each other's room list.[/h3]

notes.content: [p]This is an emergency hotfix patch[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Update Contents:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the tower’s attack range display was not updated after using the “Attack Range” attribute card[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the gold cost for drawing function cards[/p][/*][*][p]Added a bloom effect toggle in the Settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a lag issue caused by the Rail Tower when using certain function cards in-game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Note: Players on different versions cannot team up or see each other's room list[/b][/h3]

notes.title: V1.02 Update
notes.content: [p][b]This is a small patch update[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Update Contents:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]You can now use the "In-Game Configuration" directly after finishing the single-player campaign.[/p][/*][*][p]New resolution options have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the UI visuals of element cards and attribute cards when they are unavailable, making it easier for players to distinguish.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Note: Players using different versions cannot team up or see each other's room list.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: "Roguelike TD game w/ multiplayer, ultra-fun! Officially out July 26!"
notes.content:
Dear players, our game is now officially on sale! 20% off for the first release!

In the official version, you can experience:
12 defense towers with different abilities
12 defense tower bonds
6 element cards with different styles
6 attribute cards that strengthen different attributes
6 element bonds
6 attribute bonds
23 single-player maps
4 online maps(Endless Mode)

This game supports up to 4 players online. Reasonably match the defense tower formation to defend against waves of enemies with special abilities until the final victory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603679/e44d317b3265bf836a09d96810e7ec20b9cf8a21.jpg[/img]

I hope you like our game. If you think it is good, I hope you can recommend it to your friends to play together. Thank you!
